name: [Harbor Reef] ProxyCache {{proxycache.name}} unhealthy on {{kube_cluster_name.name}}
message:
ProxyCache `{{proxycache.name}}` on `{{kube_cluster_name.name}}` is reporting **unhealthy** (`harbor_reef_operator.proxycache_healthy` < 1).

This gauge is emitted by harbor-reef-operator (>= 1.2.0) from Harbor's own registry-endpoint health. A value of 0 means Harbor cannot reach or authenticate to the upstream registry for this proxy cache, so pulls through it will fail with `not found`.

Runbook:
1. `kubectl get hpc -o wide` and `kubectl describe hpc {{proxycache.name}}` for the Healthy condition message.
2. Check the backing credential secret/Vault value (for nvcr.io the username must be `$oauthtoken`).
3. The operator re-pushes credentials every reconcile; if still unhealthy after a credential fix, inspect harbor-core logs for the ping error.

team:platform
